cap: Medication abortion pairs two drugs by receptor. Mifepristone is a competitive progesterone receptor antagonist, so the decidua breaks down and the myometrium becomes sensitive to prostaglandins; at higher doses it also blocks the glucocorticoid receptor, which is why adrenal failure and long-term steroids are contraindications. Misoprostol, a prostaglandin E1 analog, then contracts the uterus and ripens the cervix, and its other use, NSAID ulcer protection, is never given in pregnancy.
